note: Status describes repository implementation only. A feature is not live until its external setup and tests are verified.

stages.title: Stage 0.4 — Version 3.3.0 Update Center
stages.summary: App and Edge Function now share a tested version-comparison module; the function validates the app-supplied current_version and reads the project URL from the Supabase Edge runtime. PWA waiting-worker prompt and user-approved activation are in the app.
stages.requires: Run Deno unit tests; deploy check-updates; apply 20261119200000_update_releases.sql; publish PWA through GitHub Pages; test update and no-update paths on Android.

stages.title: Stage 0.5 — Admin Member Broadcast
stages.summary: Owner/Super Admin/Admin-only broadcast UI, server-side permission check, in-app recipient inbox records and 3-per-hour rate limit added to repository.
stages.requires: Apply base, Admin RBAC and broadcast migrations in order; verify owner bootstrap, admin send, member inbox/RLS and delivery counts in staging.

stages.title: Stage 0.6 — Unified Inbox & Push Notification Foundation
stages.summary: Unified Inbox UI, direct/group thread list, unread counters, read markers, explicit browser push permission and subscription storage, plus Service Worker push display/click handling added to repository.
stages.requires: Apply 20261120100000_inbox_push_foundation.sql after community migration; configure VAPID public/private keys and trusted push sender; test subscription, delivery, unsubscribe and Android browser behavior.

stages.title: Stage 0 — One-Click Safe Setup
stages.summary: Consent-first local preferences, Yes/Review/Later flow added; optional analytics and sensitive permissions remain off unless separately approved.
stages.requires: Android/browser device test and review/edit persistence verification

stages.title: Stage 1 — Dashboard ও PWA foundation
stages.summary: Responsive dashboard, navigation, PWA shell এবং service-worker update flow repository-তে আছে।

stages.title: Stage 2 — Supabase Auth ও Global Community
stages.summary: Auth, profile, member search, friend requests, private/group chat frontend and SQL foundations are in the repository. User reports a basic real message-exchange test passed; broader RLS, inbox, read/unread and multi-user security tests are not yet independently verified.
stages.requires: Verify the target Supabase migrations and RLS policies; test registration/login, profile, friend requests, private/group chat, inbox and read/unread behavior with multiple accounts.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Privacy & Data Rights
stages.summary: Consent sync, append-only consent events and access/correction/deletion request queue are present in code/migrations.
stages.requires: Apply privacy migration, authenticated tests, deletion fulfilment workflow, policy and legal review.

stages.title: Stage 4 — AI Assistant ও Image Search
stages.summary: AI Edge Function foundation exists; provider integration is not verified live.
stages.requires: AI_PROVIDER_API_KEY secret, provider/model configuration, function deployment and response/license tests.

stages.title: Stage 5 — Facebook Discovery ও Active User Finder
stages.summary: Currently UI/plan; real discovery is not live.
stages.requires: Meta app, approved permissions/data access, consent-first manual workflow and policy review.

stages.title: Stage 6 — Referral, Notifications ও Admin
stages.summary: Owner-controlled Admin RBAC UI, notifications foundation and broadcast workflow exist in repository; migrations and device delivery tests remain.
stages.requires: Verify owner account, apply migrations, test RLS/RPC, configure push/email provider and verify on device.

stages.title: Stage 7 — Android APK
stages.summary: Android WebView wrapper and debug build workflow exist; production signing and physical-device test are not verified.
stages.requires: Install and test debug APK, configure protected release signing key and build release APK/AAB.

stages.title: Stage 8 — Google Play Store
stages.requires: Developer account, signed AAB, store listing, privacy declarations, policy review and Play approval.
